stemMd: The passage presents improvisational originality as

options.label: A
options.textMd: something that can be measured only by counting new notes.

options.label: B
options.textMd: the complete absence of any practiced pattern.

options.label: C
options.textMd: a process unrelated to other performers.

options.label: D
options.textMd: responsive use and modification of learned resources in a particular performance.

explanationMd: The author rejects a simple preparation-versus-invention opposition. Learned patterns enable rapid response, while originality lies in their context-sensitive use, interruption, and relation to other players.

distractorRationale.c: Interaction is the central source of the described choices.
distractorRationale.a: The passage emphasizes placement, duration, and silence.
